faq.q: How do I install Sniper 3D on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Sniper 3D and check the developer is Wildlife Studios before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.1 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Wildlife Studios and may be altered, so the safest way to play Sniper 3D is the official listing.

faq.q: How do I upgrade guns in Sniper 3D?
